scope: Evaluate the newly visible CADMPEG standalone SAT/SAB reader as an optional independent ACIS payload cross-reader and determine whether it can satisfy semantic-evidence or DWG/DXF wrapper gates.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, package metadata, source-tree, corpus-manifest, and open-items audit
method.evidenceBoundary: The published package and source tree describe a read-only standalone SAT/SAB parser and neutral B-rep transfer path, not DWG/DXF or AcDs ownership. The source's own L1 profile and open-items list constrain semantic use; direct/embedded parity shares the same decoder. The visible corpus manifest has no SAT entry, and the provenance/oracle of the codec golden directory was not established. GitHub main/workspace version metadata and docs.rs 0.6.1 were not bound to the same immutable source artifact. No runtime result, local defect, support promotion, or external-J resolution was established.

observed: The published codec describes bare ASM/ACIS SAT/SMT/SAB/SMB reading, with save-format 217/218 as verified ACIS bands and transfer to a neutral B-rep model.
The route is read-only and does not parse DWG/DXF containers or encode SAT/SAB output.
The project describes explicit decode losses and unknown-record/source-fidelity retention.
The project tree is separate from the ACadRust/OpenCADStudio parser family and the cq-acis/OCCT route; this is a distinct implementation candidate, not independent semantic proof.
doesNotEstablish: correct extraction of an ACIS payload from a libdxfrw DWG/DXF entity
3DSOLID/REGION/BODY owner binding or R2013+ AcDs section linkage
native application acceptance, general ACIS correctness, or a geometry result matching independent truth
evidence.planUse: Retain as an optional cross-reader at the existing composed ACIS checkpoint, limited to exact extracted payload spans and separately authored expected geometry.

observed: docs.rs lists cadmpeg-codec-sat 0.6.1 with a 2026-10-12 release date.
The inspected mutable GitHub main workspace manifest identifies version 0.6.0; the reviewed package docs and main source are not demonstrated to be the same artifact.
The project identifies Apache-2.0 code and CC-BY-4.0 documentation and publishes clean-room/provenance rules.
doesNotEstablish: the 0.6.1 source commit, archive checksum, transitive lock, enabled features, or runtime behavior from mutable main documentation
evidence.planUse: Require exact crate archive SHA-256, corresponding source commit, resolved dependency lock, toolchain/features/platform, and invocation before any peer run; otherwise record NOT_RUN.

observed: The format-support document scores standalone SAT/ACIS at L1 while documenting B-rep transfer as extra capability for 217/218.

The open-items document records unresolved cases including missing-partner coedge behavior, body-kind inference by edge-use counts, pcurve interval tolerance/fallback, cone pcurve chart sign/scale, and procedural normal orientation.
The direct and embedded routes share the ACIS decoder, so their parity is internal consistency rather than an independent-reader comparison.
doesNotEstablish: topology, trims, orientation, body-kind or placements for unresolved families
semantic truth from a passing generated self-roundtrip or same-codec direct/embedded comparison
evidence.planUse: Only compare cases whose expected topology and analytic geometry are separately known and whose semantics avoid the listed open items; report all losses, unknown carriers, and incomplete connected topology.

evidence.topic: Public corpus and self-test provenance boundary
observed: The inspected public corpus manifest lists FreeCAD FCStd fixtures and no SAT entry.
The SAT codec tree exposes a tests/golden directory, but the opened metadata does not establish the input provenance or an independently authored semantic oracle for those tests.
The corpus policy calls for authored, declared CC0 samples; expected topology is optional.
doesNotEstablish: a public native SAT/SAB regression corpus or independently verified geometric truth
evidence.planUse: Treat the peer's test suite as source/regression evidence only until each SAT/SAB input and expected result has been provenance-audited. Add no third-party drawing fixture under this plan update.
